comment: makemon.c makemon() with MM_ADJACENTOK on an occupied square relocates the new monster with enexto_core() instead of failing. A Healer raised to experience level 9 leaves a wished statue of a dwarf on the floor, steps off it, surrounds itself with eight brown molds (one on the statue), and casts stone to flesh at the statue: trap.c animate_statue() passes MM_ADJACENTOK for ANIMATE_SPELL, and the dwarf appears next to the mold. Two searches let it act.
